What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is designed to ensure a smooth process for you:
Return Window: You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Condition of Items: Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear should not have been worn outdoors.
Return Process: Once you’ve registered your return through our returns portal, we ask that the item(s) are posted back to us within 5 days.
Refund Timeline: After your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days. Once approved, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund is processed.
Special Cases: For hygiene reasons, boxers can only be returned if unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
Please ensure your parcel is securely packaged and retain proof of postage until your return is processed. For full details, you can view our returns policy here.
